The function has optional rating param. We can set rating to maybe 4.5? But the function's rating param is optional; we can set rating to 4.5 to filter high-rated. That will return restaurants with rating >= 4.5. Then we can pick 4 from the results.

We need to produce a response that includes the results from the function calls. We should do the calls sequentially. We'll first call restaurant_search for Chinese restaurants near New York. Then call restaurant_search for Italian restaurants in Los Angeles with rating 4.5. Then call flight_search for round-trip flight.
